signature_push.label: Push Signature
signature_push.description: Updates the Gmail signature and syncs the profile

csvStep.csvEmpty: CSV file is empty or invalid.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Bulk Operations lets you apply an action to many users at once from a CSV file: pushing Gmail signatures, suspending or permanently deleting accounts.

sections.heading: Step by Step
paragraphs: The page is a four-step wizard:

bullets.desc: Choose Push Signature, Suspend or Delete.
Upload the CSV file containing the users to process.
Valid and invalid rows are listed; you can skip invalid rows and continue.
The operation starts and progress is shown in real time.

sections.heading: CSV Template
paragraphs: Each action type has its own columns. Use the "Download CSV Template" button on the Upload step to download an empty file in the correct format and fill it in.

sections.heading: Execution & Monitoring
paragraphs: The operation becomes a background job; a progress bar, success/failure counters and the currently processed user are shown. Completed operations are listed on the Job History page, where an error report can be downloaded.

callout.text: Operations are rate-limited to respect the Google API quota; large lists may take time. You can stop a run at any time with Cancel.
